assessments.reasoning: The package distinguishes the two types and their respective null values. Paragraph 14/2 specifies the three exact null-call branches asserted.

challenge.method: Compare §11.4.1(2/5,3/5,7,10/2–14/2) and check null occurrence on three different operations alongside a null identity.
challenge.results: Exception_Identity maps the null occurrence to the null identity. Reraise_Occurrence has no effect. Raise_Exception with a null identity raises Constraint_Error. The other exception querying operations have their own null conditions.

limitations: The claim concerns these explicit null-argument branches only. It leaves naming, message retrieval, propagation of non-null occurrences, and representation outside this scope.
Exact unannotated Ada 2022 manual edition only. Runtime implementations and other editions require separate evidence.
